We need: `forall r | i <= r < k :: a[r] < x`

attempts.diagnosis: The loop is missing the left-side invariant that tracks elements already known to be less than x. The existing invariant only records that elements from k+c onward are >= x (the right side). After the loop exits with c==0, Dafny knows forall r | k <= r < i+n :: a[r] >= x, but it has no fact establishing forall r | i <= r < k :: a[r] < x because that property was never stated as an invariant. The postcondition on line 58 therefore cannot be derived from the conjunction of invariants and !G. The invariant is actually maintainable: when k advances to k+c+1, sortedness of the array (a precondition) together with a[k+c] < x implies all elements in [k, k+c] are < x, preserving the left invariant.
